errors.board_required: board_id is required: a batch moves tasks of one board
errors.task_ids_count: task_ids must list between 1 and {max} tasks; it lists {count}
errors.note_required: note is required: say why these tasks move, it is written on each one
errors.sha_invalid: deployed_sha must be a commit SHA (7 to 40 hex characters)
errors.included_needs_deploy: require_included needs deployed_sha and project_id: inclusion is checked against one project's deployed commit
errors.unknown_stage: {stage} is not a column of this board
errors.not_forward: {to} does not come after {from} on this board: a batch only moves tasks forward
errors.run_before_merge_target: a run moves tasks in a batch only from {target}, the stage where merged work waits, or a later one; {stage} comes before it (a board without that stage takes no batch from a run)

comments.moved: {by} moved the task to {stage} in a batch: {note}
comments.moved_deploy: {by} moved the task to {stage} in a batch, with deploy {sha}: {note}

log.comment: comment the batch move on task {task}
